_context.common.dateAtTime: A deadline to the minute, always in UTC. {date} is a day and month already formatted ("12 March"), {time} a 24-hour time ("16:00").
_context.common.meta: Short uppercase labels of a two-column table of facts in an email (label on the left, value on the right).
_context.common.footer.tagline: Last line of every email, under a rule, in small grey text.
_context.reasons: A small grey line under the first paragraph of a notification email: why this person receives it. {agentName} is a coworker's name.
_context.incidentResolved.sources: The thing that works again, used as {source} in the incident emails. {slug} is the technical name of a schedule or a trigger, shown as is.
_context.agentNotification: Notification emails a coworker sends. The heading is the email's title, the body names the coworker in bold.
_context.agentIdle.createdHoursAgo: Value of the "Created" row of a table: how long ago a coworker was created.
_context.agentIdle.createdYesterday: Value of the "Created" row of a table: how long ago a coworker was created.
_context.agentIdle.createdDaysAgo: Value of the "Created" row of a table: how long ago a coworker was created. Never 1, which reads createdYesterday.
_context.automateAgent.periods: Used as {period} in automateAgent.body: "in the last week".
_context.archiveExpiring: {kind} is "sandbox" for a creator's free sandbox, anything else for a paid workspace that was paused.
_context.creatorInvite.button: "Box" is the coworkers' machine, a product name kept as is.
_context.creatorInvite.signoff: Signature at the bottom of the email.
_context.trialStarted.perMonth: {price} is an amount with its currency ("$49").

footer.tagline: Run your work on coworkers. Build them, watch them work, and keep your eyes on everything.

reasons.everything: You get every run in the workspace.

signInCode.bodySignIn: Enter this code in the tab where you asked for it, or use the button below to sign in right away.
signInCode.bodyConfirm: Enter this code in your Rerun account settings to make this the email of your account.
signInCode.footnoteSignIn: The code and the button expire in {minutes, plural, other {# minutes}} and work once. If you didn't ask for them, you can safely ignore this email.
signInCode.footnoteConfirm: The code expires in {minutes, plural, other {# minutes}} and works once. If you didn't ask for it, you can safely ignore this email.

publishedAccessCode.heading: Open {pageTitle}
publishedAccessCode.body: {workspaceName} shared this page with you. Enter this code on the page to open it.
publishedAccessCode.footnote: The code expires in {minutes, plural, other {# minutes}} and works once. If you didn't ask for it, you can safely ignore this email.

workspaceInvite.heading: You're invited
workspaceInvite.bodyWithInviter: {inviter} invited you to join {workspaceName} on Rerun.
workspaceInvite.bodyAnonymous: You've been invited to join {workspaceName} on Rerun.
workspaceInvite.pitch: Rerun runs your business with autonomous AI coworkers. Accept the invite to start collaborating in this workspace.
workspaceInvite.footnote: This invitation expires in 7 days. If you weren't expecting it, you can safely ignore this email.

teamInvite.heading: Bring your team into {workspaceName}
teamInvite.firstRun: {agentName} completed its first successful run, and you are still the only person in this workspace.
teamInvite.access: If someone else should read its results, approve what it is about to do, or keep its workflow running when you are away, they need their own access.
teamInvite.footnote: You decide who joins. Nothing is shared until you send an invitation.

runFailed.heading: Run failed
runFailed.body: Your coworker {agentName} stopped with an error.

budgetExhausted.preview: Your Rerun credits are used up
budgetExhausted.heading: Rerun credits used up
budgetExhausted.bodyNamed: The Rerun credits of {workspaceName} are used up for this month. Scheduled and triggered runs on Rerun models are paused until they reset or you add credits.
budgetExhausted.bodyUnnamed: Your workspace's Rerun credits are used up for this month. Scheduled and triggered runs on Rerun models are paused until they reset or you add credits.
budgetExhausted.ownKeys: Coworkers using their own API keys keep running.

info.heading: Needs your attention
info.body: Your agent {agentName} wants you to look at something.

question.heading: Coworker has a question
question.body: Your agent {agentName} needs an answer to continue.

approval.heading: Approval needed
approval.body: Your agent {agentName} is waiting for your approval.

connector.heading: App setup
connector.body: Your agent {agentName} needs you to connect a service.

incidentResolved.heading: Back to normal
incidentResolved.body: {source} of {agentName} ran fine again. You won't get another email about it unless it breaks again.

agentIdle.preview: {agentName} is ready, but hasn't run yet
agentIdle.heading: {agentName} hasn't run yet
agentIdle.body: You created {agentName} and it has never started a run. Give it one small task first: a result you can read in a minute is what tells you whether the setup is right before you put it on a schedule.
agentIdle.footnote: Opening this page does not start a run.
agentIdle.createdHoursAgo: {count, plural, one {# hour ago} other {# hours ago}}
agentIdle.createdDaysAgo: {count, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}

agentRecommendations.preview: {count, plural, one {# Rerun coworker that fits {company}} other {# Rerun coworkers that fit {company}}}
agentRecommendations.heading: Where to start at {company}
agentRecommendations.bodyWithSite: You shared {domain} during setup. From the recurring work described there and the tools you told us you use, these are the clearest setups to start with.
agentRecommendations.bodyWithoutSite: From the tools you told us you use, these are the clearest setups to start with.
agentRecommendations.footnote: Nothing runs until you pick one and review its setup.

automateAgent.preview: You've started {agentName} by hand {manualRuns, plural, other {# times}}
automateAgent.heading: Let {agentName} start itself
automateAgent.body: You started {agentName} yourself {manualRuns, plural, other {# times}} in {period}, and every one of them finished.
automateAgent.workflowWorks: The workflow works. On a schedule it does the same job without you opening the app to launch it.
automateAgent.footnote: You review the schedule before it is saved, and you can pause it at any time.

onboardingResume.heading: Your setup isn't finished
onboardingResume.leftEarly: Your workspace is created, but you left before the end of the setup. It takes about a minute: your site, and the tools you already work with.
onboardingResume.whyItMatters: Those two answers are what decide which coworkers Rerun puts in front of you. Without them you get the generic list.
onboardingResume.footnote: The questions reopen on their own when you land on your workspace.

archiveExpiring.preview: {kind, select, sandbox {Your archived Rerun sandbox is deleted on {date}} other {Your paused Rerun workspace is deleted on {date}}}
archiveExpiring.heading: {kind, select, sandbox {Your archived sandbox is deleted on {date}} other {Your paused workspace is deleted on {date}}}
archiveExpiring.statusNamed: {kind, select, sandbox {{workspaceName} has been archived since {pausedOn}. Its coworkers and everything they know are still saved, and this is the last week they will be.} other {{workspaceName} has been paused since {pausedOn}. Its coworkers and everything they know are still saved, and this is the last week they will be.}}
archiveExpiring.statusUnnamed: {kind, select, sandbox {Your workspace has been archived since {pausedOn}. Its coworkers and everything they know are still saved, and this is the last week they will be.} other {Your workspace has been paused since {pausedOn}. Its coworkers and everything they know are still saved, and this is the last week they will be.}}
archiveExpiring.deletion: {kind, select, sandbox {On {date}, the saved copy is deleted for good and cannot be recovered. Open your sandbox and request its reactivation before then to get it back exactly as you left it.} other {On {date}, the saved copy is deleted for good and cannot be recovered. Subscribe before then and your workspace comes back exactly as you left it.}}
archiveExpiring.button: {kind, select, sandbox {Open my sandbox} other {Bring my workspace back}}
archiveExpiring.footnote: {kind, select, sandbox {This is the last email about this sandbox.} other {This is the last email about this workspace.}}

creatorInvite.previewOutreach: Built from your public work. Claim your profile and your sandbox.
creatorInvite.previewApplication: You are in. Claim your sandbox and start building templates.
creatorInvite.introOutreach: Your profile was just added to our directory of professionals who design and deploy AI coworkers. We pre-filled your listing from your public work.
creatorInvite.introApplication: We reviewed your application to the Rerun Creator program and we would love to have you on board.
creatorInvite.sandbox: The link below creates your creator account and hands you a sandbox: an unlimited workspace where you build coworkers, capture them as templates, and publish them to the marketplace. Creators keep the revenue on every paid template they ship.
creatorInvite.conditions: You will be asked to accept the program conditions before the sandbox opens. It takes a minute. Your public listing stays yours to edit from the app, whenever you want.
creatorInvite.fallbackLink: If the button does not work, paste this into your browser: <link>{url}</link>

creatorPitch.preview: Sell the coworkers you build on Rerun
creatorPitch.heading: Sell what you built
creatorPitch.bodyWithAgent: You built {agentName} in Rerun. If it solves a problem other people have too, you can package it as a template they install in one click.
creatorPitch.bodyWithoutAgent: You built working coworkers in Rerun. If one of them solves a problem other people have too, you can package it as a template they install in one click.
creatorPitch.creator: As a Rerun Creator you set the price, we handle the checkout and the payouts, and buyers land on a setup that already runs.
creatorPitch.footnoteWithAgent: Start with {agentName}, or build something for the marketplace from scratch.
creatorPitch.footnoteWithoutAgent: Start from a coworker you already have, or build something for the marketplace from scratch.

paymentFailed.preview: Your Rerun payment was declined, your workspace is paused on {pausedAt}
paymentFailed.heading: Your payment was declined
paymentFailed.declined: The renewal for {workspace} did not go through on {date}. Your bank may simply be asking you to confirm it.
paymentFailed.declinedWithAmount: The renewal for {workspace}, {amount}, did not go through on {date}. Your bank may simply be asking you to confirm it.
paymentFailed.consequences: Your workspace keeps running until {pausedAt}. After that it is paused and your coworkers stop. Nothing is deleted: your coworkers and everything they know are saved until {keptUntil}. Pay the invoice and nothing changes, on the same plan.
paymentFailed.footnote: We will try the card again over the next few days. If one of those attempts goes through, your workspace carries on, or is restored on its own if it was already paused.

renewalReminder.heading: Your plan renews in {daysLeft, plural, =1 {a day} other {# days}}
renewalReminder.body: You asked us to remind you before the plan for {workspace} renews. It renews on {date}, and the card on file is charged then. Until that date your coworkers keep running as they are.
renewalReminder.footnote: Want to cancel? Do it before {date} from Billing, in your workspace menu, and your card is not charged again.

sandboxIdle.preview: Your Rerun sandbox is archived on {date} unless you open it
sandboxIdle.heading: Your sandbox is archived on {date}
sandboxIdle.unused: Your Rerun sandbox has not been opened since {lastActive}. A sandbox keeps a machine running for you, so one that sits unused for 30 days is archived to free it.
sandboxIdle.openBefore: Open your sandbox before {date} and nothing changes. After that date its coworkers and their data are saved, but getting it back means asking us to reactivate it.

subscriptionEnding.heading: {daysLeft, plural, =1 {Your subscription ends tomorrow} other {Your subscription ends in # days}}
subscriptionEnding.cancelled: The subscription for {workspace} was cancelled and ends on {date}. On that date your coworkers stop and your workspace is paused.
subscriptionEnding.nothingDeleted: Nothing is deleted. Your coworkers, their memories, files and history are saved until {keptUntil}, and subscribing again brings it all back exactly as you left it.
subscriptionEnding.footnote: Changed your mind? Reactivating before {date} leaves everything running, with nothing to restore.

trialEnded.preview: {reason, select, payment_failed {Your first Rerun payment failed, your workspace is paused on {pausedAt}} other {Your Rerun trial has ended, your workspace is paused on {pausedAt}}}
trialEnded.heading: {reason, select, payment_failed {Your first payment failed} other {Your trial has ended}}
trialEnded.ended: {reason, select, payment_failed {The trial for {workspace} ended on {date}, and the first charge to your card did not go through. Your bank may simply be asking you to confirm it.} other {The trial for {workspace} ended on {date}, and your coworkers have stopped.}}
trialEnded.paused: {reason, select, payment_failed {Your workspace is paused on {pausedAt}. Nothing is deleted: your coworkers and everything they know are saved until {keptUntil}. Pay the invoice before it is paused to keep it running, or subscribe any time before then and it all comes back exactly as you left it.} other {Your workspace is paused on {pausedAt}. Nothing is deleted: your coworkers and everything they know are saved until {keptUntil}. Subscribe any time before then and it all comes back exactly as you left it.}}
trialEnded.button: {reason, select, payment_failed {Pay the invoice} other {Start my plan}}
trialEnded.footnote: Not the right time? You can leave it, nothing further will be charged. Your workspace stays saved until {keptUntil}.

trialEnding.heading: Your trial ends in {daysLeft, plural, =1 {a day} other {# days}}
trialEnding.endsOn: The trial for {workspace} ends on {date}. From then on your plan bills to the card on file every month. Without a card on file, your coworkers stop running and your workspace is paused 2 hours after your trial ends.
trialEnding.nothingDeleted: Nothing is deleted: your coworkers and everything they know are saved until {keptUntil}, and subscribing brings it all back exactly as you left it.
trialEnding.footnote: Not planning to continue? Cancel before {date} from Billing, in your workspace menu, and nothing is charged.

trialFinalNotice.previewNoCard: Add a card before {date} to keep your Rerun coworkers running
trialFinalNotice.heading: Your trial ends in 2 hours
trialFinalNotice.bodyCard: The trial for {workspace} ends at {date}. Your plan starts then, and the card on file is charged for your first month. Your coworkers keep running, there is nothing to do.
trialFinalNotice.noCard: The trial for {workspace} ends at {date}, and there is no card on file.
trialFinalNotice.noCardPause: Without a plan, your coworkers stop at the end of the trial and your workspace is paused at {pausedAt}. Nothing is deleted: your coworkers and everything they know are saved until {keptUntil}, and subscribing brings it all back exactly as you left it.
trialFinalNotice.footnoteCard: Not planning to continue? Cancel before {date} from Billing, in your workspace menu, and your card is not charged.

trialStarted.heading: Your trial is active
trialStarted.body: {workspace} is on a {trialDays}-day free trial. Your coworkers run, your schedules fire, and nothing is charged today.
trialStarted.included: {coworkers, plural, one {# coworker} other {# coworkers}} and {credits, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}}
trialStarted.footnoteCard: Your plan starts on its own on {date}: {price} is charged to the card you added, then every month. Not planning to continue? Cancel before {date} from Billing, in your workspace menu, and nothing is charged.
trialStarted.footnoteNoCard: No card needed for the trial. To keep going after {date}, add one from Billing, in your workspace menu, and your plan starts at {price}/month. Without one, your coworkers stop and nothing is charged.
